groups.title: Docker command-line tools
groups.summary: Docker's macOS command-line tools, built by Docker, Inc. and redistributed unmodified.

components.name: Docker CLI
components.notes: Includes vendored Go modules under their own licenses; see vendor.mod and vendor/ at the source link.

components.name: Docker Buildx
components.notes: Includes Go modules under their own licenses; see go.mod at the source link. github.com/hashicorp/hcl/v2 v2.24.0, github.com/hashicorp/go-cty-funcs v0.0.0-20250818135842-6aab67130928 and github.com/hashicorp/go-cleanhttp v0.5.2 are under MPL-2.0; their source is published at proxy.golang.org.

components.name: Docker Compose
components.notes: Includes Go modules under their own licenses; see go.mod at the source link. github.com/hashicorp/go-version v1.9.0 is under MPL-2.0; its source is published at proxy.golang.org.

groups.title: Linux kernel
groups.summary: The kernel of ArcBox's Linux virtual machine.

components.name: Linux
components.notes: Built from https://cdn.kernel.org/pub/linux/kernel/v6.x/linux-6.18.38.tar.xz with the configuration (configs/arcbox-arm64.config), patches, ArcBox HVC block driver and build script in the source repository. boot-assets v0.8.12 records this kernel's ref as "latest"; it is the v0.0.25 build (sha256 a122ce7a69a77408eeef9423afd9f6915828ba74a767e3e1eace635f913e02c4).

groups.title: Linux root file system
groups.summary: The read-only root file system of ArcBox's Linux virtual machine, built by boot-assets v0.8.12 (https://github.com/arcboxlabs/boot-assets/tree/v0.8.12) from upstream source releases and Alpine Linux 3.19 packages.

components.name: BusyBox
components.notes: PID 1 and the shell utilities. Alpine's build recipe: https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/tree/3.19-stable/main/busybox

components.name: btrfs-progs
components.notes: btrfs and mkfs.btrfs, statically linked with zlib, LZO, Zstandard, libblkid and libuuid.

components.name: e2fsprogs
components.license: GPL-2.0-only AND LGPL-2.0-only AND BSD-3-Clause AND MIT
components.notes: e2fsck and mkfs.ext4, statically linked. Modified by ArcBox with patches/e2fsprogs/0001-preserve-readonly-errors.patch from boot-assets v0.8.11.

components.name: erofs-utils
components.notes: mkfs.erofs, statically linked with LZ4, Zstandard, zlib and libuuid. Most of erofs-utils is MIT, but its library includes lib/hashmap.c (copied from Git) under GPL-2.0-only, so the binary as a whole is distributed under the GPL-2.0. xxhash is used under BSD-2-Clause and sha256 is public domain (Unlicense).

components.name: iptables
components.notes: iptables (legacy backend), statically linked.

components.name: nfs-utils
components.notes: rpc.nfsd, rpc.mountd, exportfs and nfsdcld. Alpine's build recipe: https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/tree/3.19-stable/main/nfs-utils

components.name: SQLite (sqlite-libs)
components.notes: Linked by nfsdcld. SQLite is in the public domain: https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html

components.name: libevent (libevent_core)
components.notes: Linked by nfsdcld.

components.name: libcap
components.notes: Linked by nfsdcld.

components.name: util-linux (libblkid, libuuid)
components.notes: libblkid is LGPL-2.1-or-later and libuuid is BSD-3-Clause. Shipped as shared libraries for the NFS utilities and statically linked into btrfs-progs and erofs-utils.

components.name: musl
components.notes: The C library and dynamic loader used by the NFS utilities.

groups.title: Container runtime
groups.summary: The Linux programs ArcBox's virtual machine runs for Docker, taken unmodified from Docker's static package https://download.docker.com/linux/static/stable/aarch64/docker-29.9.2.tgz.

components.name: Docker Engine (dockerd)
components.notes: Statically linked with the GNU C Library (listed below). Includes Go modules under their own licenses; see go.mod at the source link. These are under MPL-2.0, and their source is published at proxy.golang.org: github.com/hashicorp/errwrap v1.1.0, go-immutable-radix v1.3.1 and v2.1.0, go-memdb v1.3.5, go-metrics v0.7.0, go-msgpack/v2 v2.1.5, go-multierror v1.1.1, go-sockaddr v1.0.7, golang-lru v1.0.2 and v2.0.7, memberlist v0.7.0, and github.com/cyphar/filepath-securejoin v0.7.0 (BSD-3-Clause AND MPL-2.0).

components.name: containerd
components.notes: containerd and containerd-shim-runc-v2. Includes Go modules under their own licenses; see go.mod at the source link. github.com/cyphar/filepath-securejoin v0.7.0 is BSD-3-Clause AND MPL-2.0; its source is published at proxy.golang.org.

components.name: runc
components.notes: Statically linked with libseccomp and the GNU C Library (listed below). github.com/cyphar/filepath-securejoin v0.7.0 is BSD-3-Clause AND MPL-2.0; its source is published at proxy.golang.org.

components.name: tini (docker-init)
components.notes: Statically linked with the GNU C Library (listed below).

components.name: libseccomp
components.notes: Statically linked into runc. The binary does not record the library version; Docker builds it from Debian 13 (trixie) packages per the Dockerfile at https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/docker-v29.9.2/Dockerfile.

components.name: GNU C Library
components.notes: Statically linked into dockerd, runc and docker-init. The binaries do not record the library version; Docker builds them from Debian 13 (trixie) packages per the Dockerfile at https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/docker-v29.9.2/Dockerfile.

groups.title: Kubernetes (k3s)
groups.summary: The k3s binary, taken unmodified from the k3s v1.36.2+k3s1 release, is a self-extracting bundle that unpacks the programs below inside the virtual machine when Kubernetes is enabled.

components.name: K3s
components.notes: Includes Kubernetes, containerd, runc, flannel, CNI plugins v1.9.1-k3s1 and Go modules under their own licenses; see go.mod and scripts/version.sh at the source link.

components.name: k3s-root
components.license: GPL-2.0-only AND GPL-2.0-or-later AND GPL-3.0-or-later AND LGPL-2.1-or-later AND Zlib
components.notes: The userland tools k3s unpacks, built with Buildroot: BusyBox 1.37.0, GNU coreutils, GNU findutils 4.10.0, iptables, nftables, ebtables, conntrack-tools, ipset, ethtool 6.14, iproute2, util-linux (blkid, losetup, nsenter), fuse-overlayfs 1.13, slirp4netns 1.3.1 and pigz. Package versions and their upstream sources are defined by the Buildroot configuration at the source link.

groups.title: Sandboxes (Firecracker)
groups.summary: The virtual machine monitor and kernel that run sandbox microVMs.

components.name: Firecracker and jailer
components.notes: Taken unmodified from the Firecracker release. Includes Rust crates under their own licenses; see Cargo.lock at the source link.

components.name: Linux (microVM kernel)
components.notes: Built from https://cdn.kernel.org/pub/linux/kernel/v6.x/linux-6.18.38.tar.xz with configs/arcbox-microvm-arm64.config and the build script in the source repository.

groups.title: x86_64 emulation (FEX)
groups.summary: Runs x86_64 Linux programs inside ArcBox's Arm virtual machine.

components.name: FEX
components.notes: Built by boot-assets v0.8.12 with the patches in patches/fex (https://github.com/arcboxlabs/boot-assets/tree/v0.8.12/patches/fex). Includes third-party code under its own licenses in External/ at the source link: vixl, fmt, xxHash, jemalloc, rpmalloc, range-v3, Zydis, unordered_dense, tiny-json, SoftFloat-3e, cephes and cpp-optparse.

components.name: GNU C Library
components.notes: Statically linked into FEX, which is built as a static PIE on Ubuntu 24.04.

components.name: GCC runtime libraries (libstdc++, libgcc)
components.notes: Statically linked into FEX.

groups.title: ArcBox programs
groups.summary: ArcBox's own helper programs and the library its Linux guest agents are statically linked with. The Rust crates compiled into every ArcBox program are listed under Rust crates.

components.name: pstramp
components.notes: The process spawn trampoline ArcBox starts terminal sessions through. It has no third-party dependencies.

components.name: musl
components.version: As bundled with Rust's aarch64-unknown-linux-musl target
components.notes: The C library statically linked into arcbox-agent and vm-agent.

groups.title: Software emulation (QEMU)
groups.summary: Not included in ArcBox.app. On a Mac without hardware virtualization, ArcBox downloads this QEMU build and runs its Linux virtual machine under software emulation. The complete corresponding source of the build is published at https://boot.arcboxcdn.com/qemu/v0.1.0/qemu-darwin-arm64-v0.1.0-sources.tar.

components.name: QEMU
components.notes: qemu-system-aarch64 with TCG only, built from https://download.qemu.org/qemu-10.2.4.tar.xz with the patches in patches/ at the source link. Parts of QEMU are under other GPL-2.0-compatible licenses; see LICENSE.

components.name: GLib
components.notes: lib/libglib-2.0.0.dylib, loaded by qemu-system-aarch64.

components.name: PCRE2
components.notes: Statically linked into GLib.

components.name: proxy-libintl
components.notes: Statically linked into GLib.

components.name: libfdt (dtc)
components.notes: QEMU's dtc subproject; its device tree library is statically linked into qemu-system-aarch64.

components.name: Berkeley SoftFloat
components.notes: QEMU's berkeley-softfloat-3 subproject, whose license the QEMU build ships.

groups.title: Downloaded on demand
groups.summary: Not included in ArcBox.app. ArcBox downloads these when you use the feature that needs them.

components.name: Linux machine images
components.notes: Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Alpine Linux and Arch Linux root file systems from the Linux Containers image server, mirrored unmodified on image.arcboxcdn.com when you create a machine. Each distribution publishes the source of its packages: https://launchpad.net/ubuntu, https://sources.debian.org, https://src.fedoraproject.org, https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports and https://gitlab.archlinux.org/archlinux/packaging/packages.

components.name: kubectl
components.notes: Downloaded from dl.k8s.io when you enable Kubernetes.
